description: Protect a whole server (e.g. an Ubuntu box running several apps) with the Nemesis host agent. Mints an account enrollment key and returns the one-line install command. Run it ON the server (root) and the agent installs a systemd unit, enrolls the host, and AUTO-DISCOVERS every app — which then show up in nemesis_list_apps to approve + enforce per app. Requires NEMESIS_API_KEY.

label.description: A label for this server/key, e.g. 'prod-ubuntu-1'

name: nemesis_server_agent
